newsitem.title: INDIA: India Century shr down 7 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India Century shr down 7 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of Century Textiles fell 164 rupees or 7.05 percent to 2,161 in late trade on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, traders said.
They said the share had been hit by a sharp drop in net profit for the six months to September 30, 1996.
Century said on Monday its net profit for the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) fell to 341.8 million rupees from 1,025.3 million a year ago.
The firm said the drop in net profit was due to higher interest costs, larger provision for depreciation and provision of Minimum Alternate Tax.
Century shares plummetted 10 percent on Tuesday in reaction to the bad news.
